description: This module provides utility functions for audio processing within the Pipecat project. It includes functions for creating various types of audio resamplers, mixing audio streams, interleaving stereo channels, normalizing values, calculating loudness using EBU R128, applying exponential smoothing, converting between μ-law, A-law, and PCM formats with optional resampling, and detecting silence in audio data. Additionally, it imports specific resampler classes from other parts of Pipecat's audio processing package.

methods.name: BaseAudioResampler create_default_resampler(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a deprecated default audio resampler instance, currently configured to use SOXRAudioResampler.

methods.name: BaseAudioResampler create_file_resampler(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a resampler instance suitable for batch processing of audio files, using SOXRAudioResampler.

methods.name: BaseAudioResampler create_stream_resampler(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a resampler instance suitable for real-time streaming scenarios, using SOXRStreamAudioResampler.

methods.name: bytes mix_audio(audio1: bytes, audio2: bytes)
methods.description: Mixes two audio byte streams (assumed 16-bit PCM) into one by adding their samples and clipping the result.

methods.name: bytes interleave_stereo_audio(left_audio: bytes, right_audio: bytes)
methods.description: Interleaves two mono audio streams into a stereo stream by alternating samples from left and right channels.

methods.name: normalize_value(value, min_value, max_value)
methods.description: Normalizes a numerical value to the [0, 1] range based on specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: float calculate_audio_volume(audio: bytes, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Calculates the perceived loudness of an audio clip using the EBU R128 standard via pyloudnorm, normalized to [0, 1].

methods.name: float exp_smoothing(value: float, prev_value: float, factor: float)
methods.description: Applies exponential smoothing to reduce noise in a time series of values.

methods.name: ulaw_to_pcm( ulaw_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler )
methods.description: Converts μ-law encoded audio bytes to PCM format with optional resampling via an asynchronous call.

methods.name: pcm_to_ulaw(pcm_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler)
methods.description: Converts PCM audio bytes to μ-law format with optional resampling asynchronously.

methods.name: bytes alaw_to_pcm( alaw_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler )
methods.description: Converts A-law encoded audio bytes to PCM format with optional resampling asynchronously.

methods.name: pcm_to_alaw(pcm_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler)
methods.description: Converts PCM audio bytes to A-law format with optional resampling asynchronously.

methods.name: bool is_silence(pcm_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Detects silence in audio data by checking if maximum amplitude is below a set threshold.
